body:
## Why

Codex's first run, on a trip file that already worked with Claude Code (#67). If something goes wrong, it's the harness, not the trip file. It also gives one pair of sessions where only the harness differs: same trip, same persona. It adds to the corpus that agent evaluations (#53) score: 8 simulated trips, from two harnesses and four personas, plus the trips Joe and his wife planned. Agreed in chat on 2026-11-04.

The final itinerary isn't checked against an expected one. Live places and the workers' picks change from run to run, so two good runs can end with different hotels.

## Design

- [Simulated users README](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/simulated-users/README.md): "What Joe does" covers adding a bot user. "Check a new harness", "Start a harness", and "Check a run" cover this issue.
- `simulated-users/trips/san-francisco.md` and `simulated-users/personas/easygoing.md`.
- The Claude Code run of the same trip and persona: the results comment on #67.

## Open questions

None.

## Do

- Joe adds Codex's bot user, and picks its model, as the README's "What Joe does" says.
- Check the Codex harness, as "Check a new harness" says. That includes where its log is, and a headless start if it has one. Write what you find into the README's "Start a harness", since it holds for every Codex run. Add its bot user to `bot-users.md`.
- Run `trips/san-francisco.md` with the `easygoing` persona on the live site (`https://roadtrip.jjk3.com`), with Codex. Set it up and start it as the README's "Set up a run" and "Start a harness" say. Don't run it at the same time as another simulated user.
- Check each session as the README's "Check a run" says. Mark a failed run in Phoenix, as it says.
- If a session fails a check because of the setup, fix the setup, the trip file, the persona file, or the instructions, and run again.
- File each app bug the run finds as a new issue, as "Check a run" says. Don't fix it here.
- Note how Codex played the user differently from the Claude Code run in #67, such as how many facts it gave at once, or how it handled the changes.

## Done when

- A simulated session of the San Francisco trip, played by Codex, is in the `road-trip-agent` Phoenix project, and passes the checks.
- The README says how to start Codex and where its log is.
- The results, and how Codex differed from Claude Code, are in a comment on this issue. The app bugs found are filed.

## Ends in

A results comment on this issue, as the README's "Check a run" says. A PR only if the setup, the trip file, the persona file, or the instructions change.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
